mapper.select: SELECT p.*, p.CREATED_BY as user_id, (select a.ALLOCATION_ID from sys_user_allocation a where a.user_id = p.CREATED_BY)allocation_id, ( SELECT pp.contract_number FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.project_id ) contract_number FROM prj_project_insure p WHERE to_char(p.insure_end_date, 'yyyy/mm/dd') = to_char(date_add(sysdate, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), 'yyyy/mm/dd')

select ppi.*, ( select scvb.meaning from sys_code_b scb,sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scb.code = 'CON.INSURANCE_METHOD' and scvb.value = ppi.INSURE_METHOD ) as insure_method_n from PRJ_PROJECT_INSURE ppi where 1=1
and ppi.project_id = #{projectId}
